observations:
Torah #28 is examined for any group of 3+ concepts connected by bechina language that form an independent domain not already captured in the 3 existing packages.

CANDIDATE 1 — Wicked Scholars cluster (תלמידי חכמים שדין יהודאין): The teaching opens with an extended treatment of false scholars who receive their Torah from fallen angels and spread heresy. The text uses bechina language around their effects (בושה = עבודה זרה; כפירות = עבודה זרה), but does NOT use bechina language to equate the false scholars themselves with any other concept class. Their relationship to heresy/idolatry is stated as causal ('מְקַבְּלִים תּוֹרָה מִתַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים שֵׁדִין יְהוּדָאִין' → they fall into heresy) — this is eitza, not bechina. The false scholars are not said to BE idolatry — they CAUSE the fall into it. No independent bechina cluster is formed.

CANDIDATE 2 — Alphabet-letters cluster (אלף/בית/גימל etc.): The teaching's second half (lines 22-26) uses the alphabet letters metaphorically — זין/חית = the false scholars and their effects; הא/ואו = cries and strife; טית/יוד = hidden good and rectification of the alephs. The text says 'זַיִן חֵית — הַיְנוּ אֵלּוּ בְּנֵי אָדָם הַמְקַבְּלִים תּוֹרָתָם מִשֵּׁדִין יְהוּדָאִין, הַמְכֻנִּים בְּשֵׁם זַיִן' and 'בְּחִינַת חֵית'. While 'מְכֻנִּים' (named/called) and 'בְּחִינַת' appear, these are metonymic equalities embedded in a running alphabetical reading — not a stable bechina cluster forming an independent domain. The letters הא, ואו, זין, חית, טית, יוד are being read as allusions to the Torah's themes rather than equated to each other as sharing a common nature. They do not form a connected component among themselves. No new package is warranted.

CANDIDATE 3 — Sages of Athens / Building in the Air (סָבֵי דְּבֵי אַתּוּנָא cluster): The story of the Athenian sages and their riddle is decoded allegorically — 'building a house between heaven and earth' = relying on false scholars = building without foundation. The text uses 'כְּאִלּוּ רוֹצִים לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת בַּאֲוִירָא' and 'כִּי תַּלְמִידֵי-חֲכָמִים שֵׁדִין יְהוּדָאִין הֵם פּוֹרְחִין בָּאֲוִיר'. This is metaphor/mashal language, not bechina ('X הוא בחינת Y'). The building-in-air image is an eitza illustration of the false scholars' lack of foundation, not an independent bechina cluster.

CANDIDATE 4 — Rectification cluster (תיקון האלפין / inviting sages / תמיד gematria): The teaching ties together הַמַּכְנִיס אוֹרְחִים (hosting sages), תמיד (gematria 4 alephs), כבש, and the rectification of the fallen alephs. These are primarily eitza connections (doing X achieves Y). The bechina equalities within this group (עולת תמיד = תולעת יעקב, קרבן עולה = לאה) are already captured in Packages 1 and 2. No additional independent bechina cluster of 3+ nodes forms here.

CONCLUSION: The 8 bechina edges of Torah #28 are fully accounted for by 3 packages. The Torah's other conceptual material (false scholars, alphabet letters, Athens riddle, tamid gematria, inviting sages) is organized through eitza (causal) language rather than bechina (shared-nature) language. No new package is warranted.
